statutory_provisions: IPC s.302, s.34; s.304 Part I
confession: Extra judicial confession made by the accused to the prosecution witness, which fact got corroborated from the statement of the doctor
trial_court_outcome: Convicted under Section 302 IPC and sentenced to life imprisonment with fine of Rs. 5000/-
offence_finally_established: Culpable homicide not amounting to murder
neutral_facts: The accused and the victim were involved in an altercation after consuming liquor. The accused assaulted the victim, resulting in the victim's death. The accused was found with blood-stained clothes and had injuries consistent with the assault. The victim's body showed multiple injuries, including fractures and lacerations. The accused was medically examined and found to have injuries that matched the time of the incident. The prosecution relied on circumstantial evidence, including the accused's extra judicial confession and medical reports, to establish the accused's involvement in the victim's death.
